newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello says Australia dollar strong.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello says Australia dollar strong.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday the Australian dollar strong at the moment and a pressure on the current account deficit and manufacturing.

Costello was asked in a news conference after the release of December quarter GDP data, if he were concerned about retail sales feeding through into higher imports and a wider current account deficit.

"Traditionally speaking as the economy strengthens so too, you see, the purchase of imports strengthen, and you also have contributing to that a currency which is pretty strong at the moment," Costello said.
Later, asked about the outlook for manufacturing Costello said: "What are the problems manufacturers are struggling with?"
"Well, as I've said before the currency is quite high, that's always a pressure for manufacturers and wage demands are very high," Costello said.
Neverthless, he said these was every reason for manufacturing to have a good outlook.

The Australian dollar has risen sharply in the last couple of weeks and measured against a basket of currencies reached 60.6 on Tuesday, matching its high reached in last December which was then a five year peak for the currency.
